  (P : Algebra.PreSubmersivePresentation R S ι σ) [inst_3 : Finite σ],
  (LinearIndependent S fun j i => (MvPolynomial.aeval P.val) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (P.map i)) (P.relation j))) →
    Submodule.span S

        ⊤ →
      IsUnit P.jacobian
